messages:
people-ops: Quick favor — candidate for SRE IC3 onsite tomorrow needs panel confirmation. Current slot 4:00pm PT. Panel: Elena (infra), Samir (prod infra), Aisha (oncall). @elena @samir @aisha please confirm by EOD.
elena: I can do 4pm PT. Recording consent is fine — will sign form.
samir: I can cover infra but have a support rotation overlap 3:50-4:10pm. Can join 3:40 to catch up; ok with 4 if we give me a 10m handoff.
aisha: I'm booked 4:00-4:30 PT. Can we move to 3:30 or swap with Priya? @recruiter_jordan any flexibility?
people-ops: Candidate prefers after 3pm PT, so 3:30 is acceptable. Priya is listed as optional — Priya ok to swap?
recruiter_jordan: Priya can cover; candidate prefers 3:30-4:00 PT window. Updating invite now. Sending recording consent link: https://forms.gle/some-token
sre-oncall-bot: note: Samir is on-call rotation overlap detected 2025-11-18 15:50 PT — pager handoff advised.
samir: thanks for the heads-up bot. I'll do the handoff at 3:45 and be ready by 3:50. 3:30 start is tight for me, 3:40 preferred.
people-ops: Ok final proposal: move start to 3:40 PT, panelists Elena + Samir + Priya, Aisha off. Samir can arrive early for handoff. Rubric update: mark 'oncall incident triage' as required probe and weight infra/system design to 30%.
elena: nice — can you add a candidate anchor question: "walk me through a production degradation you owned"? that's a good prompt.
people-ops: Added. I'll push rubric updates to the debrief doc and will ping the panel 30min before with the live scoring link. After interview, please leave 3 quick bullets: (1) area strengths (2) risks (3) hire rec. Will send debrief reminder.
recruiter_jordan: Calendar updated to 3:40 PT, invite sent to candidate, consent form received from Elena. Candidate confirmed availability.
people-ops: Awesome — thanks all. Final timestamps: thread created 6801234567. I'll post the debrief reminder 30m before session. :thumbsup:
